notes.title: The King of Cats - Patch 2.1.2
notes.notes:
Greeting, kitten kings and queens!

This is a simple patch that should hopefully streamline Steam achievements and prevent repeated achievements.

notes.title: The King of Cats - Patch 2.1.1
notes.notes:
Greetings, kitty kings and kitty queens!

This update is small and simple. It fixes some typos and adds color tags to some names that were colorless.

Soon to come will be a partial French translation!  And if I'm feeling really crazy, I might even add a custom GUI!  We'll see how the kitties feel.

Try out the game for FREE and drop any comments and feedback and reviews and complaints and whatever I don't even care it's a free game.

notes.title: Patch 2.1: Typo fixes
notes.notes:
Greetings again, kitten kings and queens and everything in between!

Patch 2.1 is an embarrassing day-one patch simply fixes some mistakes in the text with regard to character name colors.  A few sentences here and there were also tightened up.

Anyway, there's not much more to say except let me know in the forum if you notice any mistakes or have any ideas for improvement!
